tsubaki15: Tsubaki: Just where did our client get all of this material anyway? You would think that you would send some of us to collect the material, or even me for that matter if it's a matter of going deep into the Dungeon.
hephastois20: Hephastois: That's because they're collected from outside of Orario.
hephastois20b: Hephastois answered, making the half-dwarf blink upon hearing this.
tsubaki16: Tsubaki: Really now? If that's the case, shouldn't you send some of the lower levels out to collect it? I'm sure it's worth the time and effort.
hephastois21c: Hephastois: As it turns out, our client has a specific Skill that allows him to get this kind of material in the first place. If anyone else attempted to try, they'll be met with empty results.
tsubaki17: Tsubaki: Seriously!? A Skill that allows you to get rare materials!? What I would give to have a Skill like that.
tsubaki17b: Tsubaki groaned with a small envious look, before she blinked at a certain detail that Hephastois mentioned.
tsubaki17c: Tsubaki: Wait, you said Skill. So our client is an Adventurer?
tsubaki17d: Tsubaki questioned, making Hephastois nod at her.
hephastois22: Hephastois: Yes, his name is Sora, a recent adventurer who joined the Hestia Familia. A boy full of mysteries and surprises...
hephastois22b: Hephastois explained while narrowing her eyes, thinking about Sora.
p265: Honestly, even thinking about Sora is giving her a small headache at how he's able to pull off all these ridiculous ideas and items.
tsubaki18: Tsubaki: So he's here in Orario...
tsubaki18b: Tsubaki mused while gaining a thoughtful look.
p266: As she turned to look at the Gummiship layout, she didn't allow her Goddess to see the expression growing on her face.
p267: Tsubaki honestly wanted to work with all of the Synthesis materials before her and have a lot of fun forging with every single piece.
p268: But as Captain, she needs to be fair and fairly distribute them amongst the Familia.
p269: She can't go around hogging all of it to herself.
p270: Even so, to have all of those rare materials no worked on by her is greatly vexing, and she's sure that it's a sentiment shared with a majority of the smiths in the Familia.
p271: It's only natural for any smith to seek out and hoard any rare smithing material and craft the greatest masterpiece that they could make.
p272: Tsubaki is no different. She wanted to see what every single material is capable of making, and she's missing a lot of those opportunities because she has to fair and share them amongst the Familia.
tsubaki_thought2: Tsubaki: '...That doesn't exactly stop me from finding a way to channel a majority of those synthesis materials to myself...'
tsubaki_thought2b: Tsubaki thought as a small smirk formed on her face, already forming a plan in her head.
p273: The first step is finding Sora.
p274: A day has passed and once again, the Hestia Familia and their Supporter have finished their dive into the Dungeon once again. The trio were making their way out of Babel, while being greeted with the sight of the sun setting, signaling the end of the day.
sora42: Sora: Well that was certainly a busy day...
sora42b: Sora remarked while rolling his shoulders.
bell49b: at the beginning of the 9th floor.
lili37: Lili: Lili can't believe that we're already starting on 9th floor already...
p275: To move on from the 8th floor to the 9th floor in just a day is just plain ridiculous in her opinion. Sora, she can sort of understand, considering his sheer strength and skill.
p276: But Bell was an entirely new case for her. The previous time they were on the 8th floor, he was having a decent time against the dark monsters.
p277: But today, he improved by a large margin and he was having a more easier time with the monsters on the 8th floor.
p278: Even if those dark monsters gave huge excelia gain in return, Bell's growth shouldn't have improve that much.
lili_thought11: Lili: '...They're just weird in every sense of the way.'
lili_thought11b: Lili thought to herself, before she heard a growl making itself known.
p279: She blinked when she heard that noise, and turned to see Sora standing there while looking at his stomach. Sora simply gave a good-hearted chuckle.
sora43: Sora: Guess all that monster hunting made me hungry.
bell50: Bell: I guess we could go for dinner right now.
bell50b: Bell said, before he blinked upon remembering something.
bell50c: Bell: Ah, we haven't been to the Hostess in a while. Let's go there.
sora44: Sora: Good idea. I'm actually craving some fried fish actually. Still gotta learn how it's cooked!
sora44b: Sora said, craving some fish. He's been wanting to learn from Mia and her cooking techniques.
p280: It was then Bell turned towards Lili.
bell51: Bell: Oh, Lili. Would you like to join us as well? It'll be our treat after all the work that you've done for us.
p281: Lili blinked in surprise, being offered dinner by these two. She was even more baffled that the two are willing to pay for her meal.
shakti_intro_b: A feminine voice cut off Lili, and gained everyone's attention as they turned to see who was asking that question.
p282: They saw an azure haired woman wearing a dark orange outfit approach them with a neutral expression.
p283: They both blinked at the sudden appearance of the woman, before Sora raised his hand.
sora45: Sora: Urm, that's me. Can I help you...?
sora45b: Sora asked with a raised eyebrow.
p284: The woman in question simply cleared her throat before introducing herself.
author_note_intro: And that's a wrap to this chapter.
author_note_p1: Oh Sora, even when you try to keep things under wraps, your presence is already making you a prime target to so many people and Gods. And now you're already in sights of Ganesha.
author_note_p2: How will Sora deal with the attention of the God of Masses?
author_note_outro: The only thing is to find out...next chapter!
fun_fact_body: Kingdom Hearts Re:Coded game design was made when Tetsuya Nomura got drunk. Yes, even when drunk, Tetsuya Nomura's mind is able to come up with these ludicrous ideas, and reflects onto the gameplay of KH Re:Coded.
